This gate is shut tight. A floor
plate somewhere in this hall swaps it.

This crystal is dark. A crystal
plate somewhere in this hall wakes it.

Not yet. Beat {left} more in my
hall, then come and find me.

That's as far as the story goes
for now. Aurelith isn't ready yet.

You're free to keep exploring.
Try not to break anything.

Halfway there. Let me fix your
team up. No charge, this once.

All rested. The next room won't
go easy on you.

I've already patched your team up
this run. You're on your own now.

Not so fast. You get through my
second before you get to me.

The stars say you lose here.
I'd rather check that myself.

Go on, the fighter is waiting.

Better luck on your next run.
after:
